description: Note: This final update was published in the Williston Observer as a two-part series. Article #1: Around 2:15 am on Saturday, May 11 the Vermont House of Representatives adjourned for the 2024 session, which also concluded the biennium. We are grateful to the Williston community for trusting us to represent you in Montpelier. We appreciate this opportunity to share some of the important work of this session.
